result.title: Lower expected Fisher rank implies better PAC generalization
result.summary: Deep learning architectures tend to generalize well to unseen data, but explaining this capability is still an open area of research. Under the assumption of i.i.d. data, PAC-Bayes provides a bound on generalization error, and its tightness relies on a parameter distribution that covers a large volume of low-loss solutions. The Fisher information metric endows the parameter space with a geometry for which distances reflect functional changes, and whose zero-component captures functional invariances. We define and study a Fisher-aligned parameter distribution for which we can simultaneously guarantee (1) a low-loss, thanks to the exploration constrained on the functional invariances and (2) a large log-volume of parameters, proportional to the number of zero eigenvalues. This distribution results in a high-probability generalization error bound, which scales with the expected rank of the Fisher information matrix, shedding light on the relevance of this quantity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 i.i.d. 与 PAC-Bayes 框架下构造一种 Fisher 对齐的参数分布：把探索限制在函数不变的方向上以保持低损失，同时使参数对数体积随 Fisher 矩阵零特征值数目增大，从而得到随 Fisher 期望秩缩放的泛化误差界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「期望 Fisher 秩与零特征值刻画函数不变性」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 状态有效维度、信息保留与容量评价的度量方式；但材料完全未涉及视觉或多模态推理，需较多推断。
